summary: Sabre Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a $1.35 billion senior secured notes offering due 2032 by unit Sabre Financial Borrower, upsized $250 million from the originally announced $1.1 billion, priced September 15, 2026. Concurrently, Sabre Financial launched an any-and-all cash tender for its 11.125% senior secured notes due 2029 plus a consent solicitation, and Sabre GLBL began tender offers for its 10.750% 2029, 10.750% 2030 and 11.125% 2030 secured notes. Proceeds fund the tenders in a liability-management refinancing. Watch tender participation and proration/consent outcomes.
